docs.desc: PRESS RELEASE TITLED "CELLEBRITE REPORTS THIRD-QUARTER 2026 RESULTS"

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: David Barter, Cellebrite’s CFO, said, “Cellebrite’s third-quarter free cash flow of $51.8 million reflects our strong operating results. Based on our year-to-date performance and the near-term opportunities we see, we are reaffirming our full-year 2026 ARR outlook while fine-tuning this year’s revenue targets to reflect more ratable revenue from cloud and AI and less hardware revenue compared with the third quarter. We have also raised our full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA outlook to $163 million to $166 million to reflect the outperformance from the third quarter. We remain well positioned to deliver a free cash flow margin of approximately 30% for the full year.”
The Company’s fourth quarter and full-year 2026 financial expectations are as follows:

Fourth-Quarter 2026 Expectations | Full-Year 2026 Expectations
(as of 11/12/26) | (as of 11/12/26)
ARR | -- | $550 million - $560 million
Annual Growth | -- | 14% - 16%
Revenue | $145 million - $150 million | $553 million - $558 million
Annual Growth | 13% - 16% | 16% - 17%
Adjusted EBITDA | $47 million - $50 million | $163 million - $166 million
Adjusted EBITDA margin | 32% - 33% | 29% - 30%
